company.name: Upfort
company.shortDescription: Upfort is a cyber security and insurance platform that offers comprehensive protection against evolving cyber threats.
company.description: Upfort is a cyber security and insurance platform that offers comprehensive protection to SMEs against evolving cyber threats. It allows organizations to fully address their cyber security needs–from risk management tools to insurance policies–through one easy-to-use platform. Its software provides phishing simulation, public Wi-Fi protection, inbox protection, password management, and cyber liability insurance.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $8,000,000, or 53.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,695,435 to $49,027,395, a 10.44x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
